events.label: US downgrade selloff
events.detail: The US credit downgrade and euro-area stress drove a volatility shock.
events.decision: High volatility. Volatility cut the rule base to 0.65x; the learned tilt added risk (1.15x). Final target: 0.74x.

events.label: China growth shock
events.detail: A global equity selloff tested how quickly the policy reduced its volatility budget.
events.decision: Elevated volatility. Volatility set the rule base at 0.84x; the learned tilt stayed near neutral (1.05x). Final target: 0.89x.

events.label: Q4 risk-off
events.detail: Tightening fears and slowing growth pushed QQQ into a sharp fourth-quarter drawdown.
events.decision: High volatility. Volatility cut the rule base to 0.64x; the learned tilt added risk (1.40x). Final target: 0.89x.

events.label: COVID crash
events.detail: Pandemic liquidation produced the highest realized volatility in the replay.
events.decision: Extreme volatility. Volatility cut the rule base to 0.26x; the learned tilt added risk (1.30x). Final target: 0.34x.

events.label: Inflation and rates
events.detail: Persistent inflation and rapid rate repricing deepened the technology bear market.
events.decision: Extreme volatility. Volatility cut the rule base to 0.49x; the learned tilt added risk (1.40x). Final target: 0.69x.

events.label: Tariff shock
events.detail: A policy-driven selloff caused a fast volatility and exposure adjustment.
events.decision: High volatility. Volatility cut the rule base to 0.55x; the learned tilt stayed near neutral (1.05x). Final target: 0.57x.
